## Courses

Course materials are on GitHub, one repository per term.

{{< include _generated/courses.md >}}

## Open course materials

[**pycse: Python Computations in Science and Engineering**](/pycse/)
: A book on using Python for scientific and engineering computation, from
  numerical methods and ODEs to optimization and data analysis.
  [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/jkitchin/pycse).

[**Modeling Materials Using Density Functional Theory**](/dft-book/)
: A guide to computational materials science with DFT, VASP and the Atomic
  Simulation Environment (ASE).
  [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/jkitchin/dft-book).

[**Claude-Light**](https://github.com/jkitchin/claude-light)
: A remotely accessible instrument for learning about running experiments,
  data analysis, automation and design of experiments.
